start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kya interesting lagta hai?

turns.line: samajh nahi aaya, ek example se samjhao
turns.reply: Jaise vegetable patch ko fence karna ho: perimeter matlab boundary ke chaaron taraf ki total length. 6 m aur 4 m sides hon, kaise jodenge?
Koi baat nahi, Kabir. Perimeter ke liye sab sides jodte hain: 6 plus 4 plus 6 plus 4. Total kitna hoga?

turns.board: Rani runs 3 rounds of a rectangular park 50 m long and 30 m wide. How far does she run?
turns.reply: 6 plus 4 equals 10, aur doosri 6 plus 4 bhi 10; dono milaakar perimeter 20 metres. Ab 5 m aur 3 m wali rectangle jodiye.
